$comment: Skills, per design-bible §2. Only the M1 subset is defined so far; the remaining skills are listed in the design bible and get added as the systems behind them are built. Keys are permanent — they end up in the database.

skills.$comment: Ahead of the rest of the post-M1 list, because the opening needed it. crude_thruster was authored as the one thing players could not make, waiting on this skill, and the faction supply order that was supposed to sell it in the meantime was never built -- so the questline could not be finished at all (task 148). Everything is player-made, so the skill arrives rather than the exception staying.
skills.name: Electronics

skills.$comment: Task 194: makes the Laser Rifle. A weapon's damage comes from its crafted tier (ADR-0017), so this is the skill better weapons will need.
skills.name: Weaponcrafting

skills.$comment: Maximum health (ADR-0017): 1,000 at level 1 to 2,000 at 99. Earns a third of every combat XP award, on top of the weapon's, so it is even across weapons and cannot be trained apart from fighting.
skills.name: Constitution

skills.$comment: The stamina pool (ADR-0017, tasks 101 and 195): 100 at level 1 to 150 at 99, earning XP for stamina spent sprinting or dodging, in a fight or out of one. 100 per hundred is one XP a point, chosen by Claude as ADR-0017 gives no rate: sprinting without a break earns 36,000 an hour, so ordinary play, which sprints a fraction of the time, should reach 70 in something like 70-100 hours, beside a weapon's 50 hours of fighting. Unmeasured; set it against real play.
skills.name: Stamina

skills.$comment: The first weapon (task 194, ADR-0015). Laser, ranged, on foot: the Laser Pistol is its sibling when it exists, and takes a fifth of its XP. 12 XP per hundred points of damage is ADR-0017's estimate for level 70 in about 50 hours of fighting, to be measured against real fights.
skills.name: Laser Rifle
